name: confluencer-ledger
description: Full Stack Transaction Ledger System (Express, TypeScript, PostgreSQL/Supabase, SQLite, React, Vite)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c green,cyan "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend install --include=dev && npm --prefix backend run build
scripts.build:all: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
